title: EGPn16 peanut: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: EGPn16 peanut: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: EGPn16 peanut is a peanut variety for the Visayas. About 100 days to harvest, 1.8 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: EGPn16 is a registered peanut variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 1999 as NSIC 1999 Pn 05. BPI NCRDC, Los Baños, Laguna bred it. It takes about 100 days from sowing to harvest, with 1.81 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** about 100 days from sowing to harvest.
**Yield:** 1.81 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

EGPn16 peanut takes about 100 days from sowing to harvest. That is about the average of the 26 peanut varieties with a day count, 101.3 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 1.81 t/ha matches the average of its group, 1.85. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It was weak against rust, cercospora leaf spot, so scout for them from the early weeks.

The pests and diseases that hit peanut fields most often: [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [thrips](/pests/thrips). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A hundred seeds weigh about 54.3 grams, so the higher this number, the bigger the seed. The seed holds 22.89 percent crude protein.
Where and when to plant EGPn16 peanut

The registry recommends it for the Visayas. Mani needs loose, well drained soil to fill its pods. Pick a variety by seed size for your buyer, and one rated against rust and leaf spot for the wet season.

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 100 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 1.81 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
The registry recommends it for the Visayas. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of EGPn16?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
